title: The coach house 2108 and 2110 Prairie shared
items: Behind 2108 and 2110 Prairie now stands one two-storey brick coach house across both lots, flat-roofed behind level brick parapets, 15.5 m along the alley and 10.7 m deep. Mark Kimball built it, and Harriet Rees took its south half when she bought her lot from him in 1888.
Each half has its own carriage door, loft hatch and doors toward its own house. The south half, 25 by 35 ft and 23 ft high, still survives and was moved with the Rees house in 2014.
